tom (AE): Demo blocked — customer POSTed ~12MB body to /v1/generate and got 413. Need a quick workaround.
leah (SE): Do we know payload shape and whether they can host an internal store?
tom (AE): They batch ~8k examples in one JSON, security forbids external presigned URLs. Tried gzip; decompressed size still > limit.
ravi (runtime eng): Hosted ingress default is 8MB. Logs show: ingress: reject: body_size=12.1MB > max_body=8MB
leah (SE): Short-term options: 1) client chunk + server assemble via SDK helper, 2) pointer to an internal store we can fetch (if reachable), 3) temporary ingress increase for their org for the demo.
ravi (runtime eng): I can file EngInfra change to bump to 16MB for 72h but need Security signoff. No special billing for larger body; billing stays per-token. Note: splitting requests can increase billed tokens if you re-send the same system prompt each time.
tom (AE): They want a clear cost comparison before we propose chunking. Can someone make a simple example (single-call vs 10-split) showing token impact?
leah (SE): On it — will draft a 1-pager with sample calc + chunking snippet and uploadChunks example. Also will add a recommended pattern: store large context in a datastore and send pointers for single inference to save tokens.
ops-bot: ticket INC-4099 created: "ingress bump request for demo-org (POC)" assigned to eng-infra
